data.name: Signature Bonfire Experience
data.headline: An exclusive experience under the stars | Available Thu - Sun
data.description: End the day island-style with our Signature Bonfire Experience. Gather around an exclusive firepit with seating for up to six, a dedicated bonfire attendant and everything you need to enjoy a relaxed night beneath the palms. Toast marshmallows, make s’mores and settle in for quality time together as the sun sets over the bay.
data.highlights:
- Reserved fireside seating exclusively set up for your group
- Dedicated bonfire attendant to tend the fire and take care of the details
- Classic s’mores experience with all the essentials for roasting
- Bayfront setting on Mission Bay for a quintessential San Diego evening
- Beautiful sunset atmosphere followed by a cozy night beneath the palms
- Perfect for families, couples and groups looking to spend quality time together
- Effortless experience with the setup handled for you—just arrive, settle in and enjoy
- A signature Paradise Point memory that combines the resort’s island setting with one of Southern California’s favorite traditions

data.cancellation_summary: Please email the Recreation Department at recreation@paradisepoint.com to inform us of your cancellation.
data.cancellation_notes: We have a "12:00pm the day of" cancellation policy. If booking is cancelled after 12:00pm the day of your reservation, the full cost will be charged. If booked after 12:00pm the day of, the full cost will be charged.
data.booking_notes:
______
##Please Note
Your portable fire pit will be set 30-45 minutes prior to start time. The Recreation Team will call you on the day of scheduled bonfire to inform you of location.

Cost includes set up/breakdown of the portable fire pit, lighting of the fire pit, beach chairs (up to 6), s'mores kits, firewood, and all supplies needed.

*Food and Beverages are available for purchase on-site at Barefoot Bar and Grill, please purchase prior to your fire pit time. View the menu here: https://paradisepoint.com/san-diego-dining/restaurants-san-diego/
______
